howDoI.q: How do I give a level a different character?
How do I make a character that cannot jump?
How do I make a key honk a horn?
How do I make a monster fly away when something hits it?
How do I make a monster that blocks the way?
How do I change characters in the middle of a game?

pages.head: Welcome
pages.html:
Welcome

Take the Wheel is a Starter: a small game that shows a few Game-Maker ideas, with signs in the levels that say what you are looking at. It has two short levels and takes a couple of minutes to finish.

Play it first. Then open it in Game-Maker (Edit a copy on the home page keeps the original safe) and read the pages below, which say where each thing in the levels is made.

The keys

Left and Right walk, and in the kart they drive. Space jumps on foot and honks in the kart. F2 shows your lives, hit points and score. Walk into the kart at the end of level 1, or into the door at the end of level 2, to go on.

Game-Maker has no vehicle. A kart is a character file like Yana's, with its own pictures, its own speed and its own keys. Nothing here hurts you.

pages.head: Level 1: Hop In
pages.html:
Level 1: Hop In

The first sign says ON FOOT, YANA WALKS AND JUMPS. A blue bird sits in the road, and the A BIRD IN THE ROAD. JUMP IT sign comes before it. Press Space while you walk, and Yana goes over. The bird stays where it is.

At the end of the road a little blue kart is parked with a pennant over it. The WALK INTO THE KART TO DRIVE IT sign points at it. Walk into it and the next level begins, with Yana in the kart.

pages.head: How this level is made
pages.html:
How level 1 is made

  • Yana. Open whl.gam and pick level 1's scene. Each scene lists the files it loads. Its character slot names hero.chr and its character pictures hero.cbl, the same Yana as in every Starter.
  • The bird. Open whl.mon in the monsters editor and pick the bird. It has no path, so it sits and blinks between two pictures. Its picture's Solid boxes are checked in whl.mbl, so Yana cannot walk through it, and it takes no hit points. Its Power is 150, so touching it does not destroy it either.
  • The jump. It is hero.chr's Space sequence: a push upward that gravity then takes back. Three blocks of height clear a bird one block tall.
  • The kart. It is two map blocks in one.map, a pennant and the kart, made like the door: nothing about them is solid. The link that ends the level starts on the bottom one, at the same spot where a door would be.
  • The change. Level 1's link goes to level 2's scene. Nothing in the link mentions a character. The next scene's list of files does.

pages.head: Level 2: Take the Wheel
pages.html:
Level 2: Take the Wheel

The THE KART IS A NEW CHARACTER FILE sign stands where Yana starts, in the kart now. The next one says FAST, BUT A KART CANNOT JUMP. Press Space and nothing lifts: it honks. Drive into the first bird, which stops the kart, and the SPACE HONKS. THE BIRD FLIES OFF sign says what to do.

Press Space. A ripple of sound flies ahead of the kart. When it reaches the bird, the bird flaps up and away. The ONE HONK CLEARS ONE BIRD sign comes before the second one. Then drive through the door.

pages.head: How this level is made
pages.html:
How level 2 is made

  • The kart. Level 2's scene names kart.chr and kart.cbl in the character slots, not Yana's. Open kart.chr in the character editor. It is Yana's head over a go-kart, drawn as two blocks, one on top of the other.
  • Fast. The Right and Left sequences move 8 pixels a frame. Yana's own move 4. The wheels turn because the frames swap between two pictures.
  • No jump. A jump is a sequence with a push upward. The kart has none, so Space is free for the horn.
  • The honk. It is the Throw sequence with Space as its key and Once per key press on. Its middle frame gives birth to monster 3, the ripple, the way Yana's star is born in Throw It. It flies the way the kart last drove at 4 pixels a tick, lives 25 ticks, about five blocks, and has Power 200.
  • The bird. When the ripple touches the bird, the weaker one is destroyed. The bird's When destroyed it becomes is monster 5, the bird in flight. That one flaps between two pictures along a path five blocks across and six up, and its Lives is Until the end of its path, so it is gone at the end.
  • The exit. The door links to the The End scene in whl.gam, which plays the ending.

pages.head: What Game-Maker cannot do
pages.html:
What Game-Maker cannot do

A vehicle is only a character, and that has limits:

  • It cannot change the character inside a scene. A scene names one character file. To switch, a link takes you to another scene that names the other file, which is why this game has a level for each.
  • It cannot keep Yana's walk and add a horn. A different file starts fresh: its hit points, lives and keys are whatever that file says. Here both are set the same.
  • It cannot tell a honk which monster to hit. Anything weaker than power 200 in its way is destroyed, in the order it meets them.
  • A born monster flies from the character's own spot and the way she last moved. It cannot be aimed up or down.

pages.head: Make it yours
pages.html:
Make it yours

Try one change at a time, and play after each:

  • Set the kart's Right sequence to 4 pixels a frame. It drives like Yana walks.
  • Make the honk's life 50 ticks. It reaches ten blocks.
  • Add a jump sequence to kart.chr on another key, and a bird can be hopped as well as honked.
  • Draw a boat or a rocket in kart.cbl, and make a level that names it.
  • Give the honk a Score when destroyed by a weapon on the bird, and it pays for each one.

The home page's Starters tab has more small games like this one.
